 Sudurpashchim sets 106-run target for Lumbini in NPL qualifier 
 Nepal News 
 November 17, 2026 
 2 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: Sudurpashchim Royals set a target of 106 runs for Lumbini Lions in the first qualifier of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) held at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur. Invited to bat first after losing the toss, Sudurpashchim managed to score 105 runs for the loss of eight wickets in their allotted 20 overs.
 Captain Dipendra Singh Airee led the batting effort with a top score of 52 runs, hitting three boundaries and one six off 51 balls. The team faced early pressure, losing three wickets with just eight runs on the board after 3.1 overs. Dipendra and Ishan Pandey stabilized the innings with a 64-run partnership for the fourth wicket. Pandey contributed 27 runs. No other batter reached double digits. Opener George Munsey was dismissed for a golden duck, while Aarif Sheikh scored four runs, and both Binod Bhandari and Thanuka Dabare added three runs each.
 Lumbini bowlers maintained tight control throughout the innings. Ruben Trumpelmann was particularly economical, taking two wickets for 14 runs in his four-over spell. Sher Malla also claimed two wickets, while Abishek Gautam and Kishor Mahato took one wicket each. Lumbini is set to begin their chase shortly. In the opening match of the third season, Sudurpashchim was bowled out for 87 runs, a game that Lumbini won by seven wickets.
